name: Lake in the Woods YMCA Camps
operator_name: Fairview Lake YMCA Camps (Metropolitan YMCA of the Oranges)
description_short: YMCA Monday to Friday sleepaway camp on the Blair Academy campus in Blairstown for campers entering grades 4 to 10, who live in dorm halls and go home on weekends. Two week traditional sessions mix sports, archery, boating, ceramics and golf, with specialty weeks in fine arts, fishing, theater, robotics and rockets, and a reading program for students with dyslexia.
special_needs_notes: B.E.A.R. Camp for Dyslexia (entering grades 6 to 10, June 28 to July 9) pairs morning reading instruction and tutoring with afternoon camp; it is for students reading at a grade 4 to 7 level or with a non emotional, non behavioral IEP for reading.
swim_waterfront_notes: Daily swim lessons and free swim in Blair Academy's indoor pool, with American Red Cross lifeguards and a Water Safety Instructor; swim test on the first day.

sessions.name: Welcome Week, Golf, LW Anglers or Robots and Rockets (1 week)
Counselor in Training (4 weeks, entering grade 11)

notes: Two week sessions are $3,271 ($3,208 early bird); one week specialty weeks $1,654 ($1,622 early bird); CIT $6,542 ($6,417 early bird). Ceramics and Fine Arts, Theatre (July 26 to August 6) and B.E.A.R. (June 28 to July 9) run in the two week slots at $3,271. Free bus from New York City and Livingston, NJ on Monday and back Friday. Campers can stay the middle weekend of a two week session at Fairview Lake YMCA Camps. Lake in the Woods also runs a day camp on the same campus for ages 3 through entering grade 9 (two week sessions, regular rate $887), not listed separately here.
